_readme: THE registry. Every LLM identifier this service understands is declared here
and nowhere else - not in .env, not in service code, not in a provider class.
Laravel sends `text_llm`; the resolver in services/models.py looks it up here
and returns a provider + a real model id. Adding a model your dashboard offers
is an edit to THIS FILE and a restart - no code change, no redeploy of logic.
models      identifier -> { provider, model }. `model` is the id the
provider's own API expects, verbatim, including any vendor
providers   how to reach a provider: which .env var holds its key, which
identifier to fall back to, and the name prefixes that point at
it when an unknown identifier arrives.
default     used only when a caller sends no identifier at all (internal
Point LLM_REGISTRY_PATH at a copy of this file to override it per deployment
without rebuilding the image. That variable is a PATH, not a model name.
